Summarize greenness exposure with (auto) time-weighting

summarize_exposure.Rd

Computes per-group exposure summaries from GPS-derived intervals, with optional auto-computation of daytime dwell weights based on a local daytime window and gap handling rules. Returns time-weighted means, unbiased weighted SDs, optional unweighted unique-AOI statistics, and coverage diagnostics.

Usage

summarize_exposure(
  data,
  group = c("subject", "date"),
  value_cols = c(ndvi = "ndvi_mean", green = "frac_green_core", grey = "frac_grey"),
  weight_col = "day_dwell_sec",
  weight_fun = function(w) w,
  aoi_id = NULL,
  include_unweighted = TRUE,
  coverage_cols = c(valid = "day_dwell_sec", missing = "missing_day_sec"),
  tz_local = "UTC",
  add_date_if_missing = TRUE,
  auto_compute_weights = TRUE,
  nominal_fix_sec = 10,
  delta_t_sec = 3 * 60,
  delta_d_m = 150,
  gap_big_sec = 15 * 60,
  gap_strategy = c("exclude", "carry_forward"),
  cap_carry_forward = 5 * 60,
  day_start_hr = 7,
  day_end_hr = 22,
  progress = TRUE
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame containing at least the grouping variables (see group), the exposure value columns (see value_cols), and either a weight column (see weight_col) or the fields required to auto-compute weights: subject, timestamp (POSIXct), lat, lon.

group

Character vector of grouping columns. Defaults to c("subject","date"). If "date" is included but not present in data, it is derived from timestamp in tz_local when add_date_if_missing = TRUE.

value_cols

Named character vector mapping metric names to columns, e.g. c(ndvi = "ndvi_mean", green = "frac_green_core", grey = "frac_grey"). For each name m, the function produces m_time_weighted, m_sd_weighted, and, if enabled, m_mean_unweighted, m_sd_unweighted.

weight_col

Name of the weight column (seconds), default "day_dwell_sec". If absent and auto_compute_weights = TRUE, weights are derived (see Details).

weight_fun

Optional function applied to the weights before summarization; signature function(w) w. Examples: cap weights function(w) pmin(w, 300), presence-only function(w) as.numeric(w > 0), or function(w) sqrt(w).

aoi_id

Optional AOI identifier column (e.g., "h3" or "buffer_id"). If supplied and include_unweighted = TRUE, unweighted unique-AOI summaries are computed per group.

include_unweighted

Logical; if TRUE (default), compute unweighted statistics across unique AOIs per group (one row per AOI).

coverage_cols

Named character vector with names c(valid = "day_dwell_sec", missing = "missing_day_sec"). If both columns exist in the group, coverage metrics are reported (see Details).

tz_local

Time zone used to derive date from timestamp and to evaluate daytime windows. Default "UTC".

add_date_if_missing

Logical; if TRUE (default) and "date" is in group but missing in data, derive it from timestamp in tz_local.

auto_compute_weights

Logical; if TRUE (default) and weight_col is absent, compute day_dwell_sec and missing_day_sec from successive fixes (see Details).

nominal_fix_sec

Intended sampling interval in seconds; used to detect gaps. Default 10.

delta_t_sec

Standby-gap threshold in seconds (no movement for at least this long). Default 3*60.

delta_d_m

Distance threshold in meters below which we consider "no movement" across a gap. Default 150.

gap_big_sec

Threshold (seconds) for classifying a gap as "big/uncertain". Default 15*60.

gap_strategy

Strategy for big/uncertain gaps: "exclude" (mark as missing) or "carry_forward" (cap carry-forward dwell). Default c("exclude","carry_forward"), first value is used.

cap_carry_forward

Cap in seconds when gap_strategy = "carry_forward". Default 5*60.

day_start_hr, day_end_hr

Local hours defining the daytime window [start, end). Defaults 7 and 22.

progress

Logical; if TRUE (default), display a progress bar via cli.

Value

A data.frame with one row per group containing the summary columns described above. Returned invisibly.

Details

Auto-computation of weights (when weight_col is missing). For each subject, consecutive GPS fixes define intervals \([t_i, t_{i+1})\) with duration \(d_i = t_{i+1} - t_i\) (seconds) and displacement \(\Delta s_i\) (meters; Haversine).

Gaps are identified by \(d_i > \mathrm{nominal\_fix\_sec}\). A gap is standby if \(d_i \ge \mathrm{delta\_t\_sec}\) and \(\Delta s_i \le \mathrm{delta\_d\_m}\). A gap is big/uncertain if \(\Delta s_i > \mathrm{delta\_d\_m}\) or \(d_i \ge \mathrm{gap\_big\_sec}\).

Effective dwell for interval \(i\) is: $$ \tilde{d}_i = \begin{cases} \mathrm{NA}, & \text{if big/uncertain and strategy = exclude} \\ \min(d_i, C), & \text{if big/uncertain and strategy = carry\_forward} \\ d_i, & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases} $$ where \(C\) is the carry-forward cap (seconds).

Let \(O_i\) be the overlap (seconds) of \([t_i, t_{i+1})\) with the local daytime window \([H_{\mathrm{start}}, H_{\mathrm{end}})\) (evaluated in tz_local). The daytime dwell weight and missing daytime seconds are: $$w_i = \min(\tilde{d}_i, O_i),$$ $$ m_i = \begin{cases} O_i, & \text{if } w_i \text{ is NA and } O_i > 0 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases} $$ The function stores \(w_i\) in day_dwell_sec (or weight_col) and \(m_i\) in missing_day_sec. Intervals with \(O_i = 0\) are dropped. Weights may be transformed via weight_fun(w) before use.

Time-weighted summaries. For any attribute \(x_i\) (e.g., NDVI) with weights \(w_i\), the time-weighted mean is $$\bar{x}_w = \frac{\sum_i w_i x_i}{\sum_i w_i}.$$

The unbiased weighted standard deviation for frequency-like weights is $$ s_w = \sqrt{ \frac{\sum_i w_i (x_i - \bar{x}_w)^2}{ \sum_i w_i - \frac{\sum_i w_i^2}{\sum_i w_i} } }. $$ If the denominator is non-positive, NA is returned.

Coverage. If both coverage_cols$valid (e.g., day_dwell_sec) and coverage_cols$missing (e.g., missing_day_sec) exist, coverage is $$ \mathrm{coverage} = \frac{\sum_i \mathrm{valid}_i}{\sum_i \mathrm{valid}_i + \sum_i \mathrm{missing}_i}. $$

Output columns

For each name m in value_cols, the output includes:

  • m_time_weighted: time-weighted mean.

  • m_sd_weighted: unbiased weighted SD.

  • m_mean_unweighted, m_sd_unweighted (if requested): unweighted mean/SD across unique AOIs in the group.

If coverage inputs are present:

  • valid_day_sec, missing_day_sec: sums across the group.

  • coverage_valid_share: \(\in [0,1]\).

Grouping columns (as in group) are preserved and appear first.

See also

attach_ndvi, attach_landuse, mutate_aoi_h3, mutate_aoi_buffer

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# 1) Using precomputed weights (day_dwell_sec) and H3 AOIs
expo_daily <- gps_data |>
  summarize_exposure(
    group      = c("subject","date"),
    value_cols = c(ndvi="ndvi_mean", green="frac_green_core", grey="frac_grey"),
    weight_col = "day_dwell_sec",
    aoi_id     = "h3",
    tz_local   = "Europe/Zurich"
  )

# 2) Auto-compute weights from GPS fixes, exclude big/uncertain gaps
expo_daily2 <- gps_data |>
  summarize_exposure(
    group            = c("subject","date"),
    aoi_id           = "h3",
    auto_compute_weights = TRUE,
    gap_strategy     = "exclude",
    day_start_hr     = 7, day_end_hr = 22,
    tz_local         = "Europe/Zurich"
  )

# 3) Presence-only weighting and unique-buffer AOI stats
expo_buf <- gps_data |>
  summarize_exposure(
    group      = c("subject","date"),
    aoi_id     = "buffer_id",
    weight_fun = function(w) as.numeric(w > 0)
  )
} # }
